admin.scopeHelp: Selection changes the administration scope. It does not switch your authenticated identity.
admin.openAccess: Mandatory bearer authentication and interactive session settings.
admin.accessFailed: Administration could not be loaded. Sign in if authentication is enabled, or retry the connection.
admin.denied: Your account does not have permission to view this administration page.
admin.createTenantFirst: Create a tenant on the Tenants page, then select it to manage its resources.
admin.name: Name
admin.secretOnce: Copy this bearer token. Authorized administrators can reveal it again from Credentials.
admin.deleteUserHelp: This also removes the user’s credentials and role assignments. Existing sessions stop working.
admin.deleteTenantHelp: All access to this tenant stops. Records associated with the tenant may remain in the database.
admin.resetHelp: Set a new password for this account. All of its existing sign-in sessions will be revoked.
admin.permissionRequired: Select at least one resource type and one operation.
admin.credentialHelp: The secret will be shown once after creation. A credential is limited by its own assignments and its owning user’s permissions.
admin.assignmentHelp: User grants and credential scopes are separate. Credential access cannot exceed its owner’s access. Resource scope requires an exact resource ID.
admin.roleHelp: Built-in roles are immutable. For custom roles, add or remove permission mappings. Explicit deny rules override permit rules.
admin.denyHelp: Explicit deny wins over permit. Without a matching permit, access is denied.
admin.effectiveHelp: These are assigned policy rules. Platform administrators bypass permission checks; tenant administrators bypass checks within their tenant. Credential access is also limited by its owning user’s permissions.
admin.copyBearerToken: Copy the complete bearer token for the Authorization header
admin.regenerateTokenConfirm: Regenerate this token? The previous token will stop working immediately. Update any integrations that use it.
admin.tokenUnavailable: This older token was not retained. Regenerate it to enable reveal.
admin.tokenFailed: Unable to retrieve the token. Check your permissions and connection.

help.refresh: Reload current server data without clearing the selected filters or tenant.
help.download: Download GGUF weights from a Hugging Face repository name or full URL. Progress appears before the model is ready.
help.copy: Copy the exact value to your system clipboard. A green check confirms success, including on HTTP connections.
help.delete: Remove or revoke the selected record. Review the confirmation because this can stop access or delete local data.
help.save: Validate the form and submit its current values. Server authorization still controls whether changes are accepted.
help.cancel: Dismiss this workflow without submitting its unsaved changes.
help.create: Open a form for a new record, or start a fresh conversation without prior turns.
help.signin: Use the account email and password configured under Access. The default tenant can be left blank.
help.signout: Revoke this dashboard session and clear its locally stored sign-in token.
help.secret: Sensitive value: enter it only when changing it. Keep it private; request history redacts credential material.
help.preferences: Change this browser’s appearance or language. Your preference persists after reload.
help.stream: When enabled, display tokens as they arrive. When disabled, wait for one complete response; cancellation still works.
help.system: Instructions sent before conversation turns on every request. Changing them affects subsequent generations.
help.stop: One stop sequence per line. Generation ends when the model emits any of these sequences.
help.format: Change output formatting or thinking visibility. Model support and other request options still apply.
help.sampling: Override the server sampling default for this request. Leave empty to use the default; limits below are enforced before sending.
help.prompt: Submit text to the selected local model. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line. Generation uses the current conversation and parameters.
help.filter: Narrow server results by these criteria. Apply commits draft filters; changing the time range updates the chart and table together.
help.tenant: Choose the tenant or principal whose records are being managed. Switching scope never grants additional privileges.
help.security: Controls authorization or record availability. Explicit deny takes precedence and credential access cannot exceed its owner’s permissions.
help.tokens: Measured model token usage. Missing counts are unavailable, not zero; cached counts depend on engine support.
help.timing: Recorded UTC timestamp or elapsed duration. Timings may overlap; approximate backend phases are marked in request details.
help.size: Amount of retained data or configured memory. Body limits can truncate content; original byte counts remain visible.
help.headers: HTTP metadata for this exchange. Authorization, cookies and other secret headers are redacted before retention.
help.body: Captured content for this exchange. Retention limits and redaction may omit content; inspect the byte and truncation indicators.
help.endpoint: Server address, route or storage location used by this setting. Server filesystem paths refer to the backend host, not this browser.
help.model: Choose or inspect a locally registered model. Downloading weights and loading them into memory are separate operations.
help.inspect: Open the selected record or operation to inspect its details and available actions before making changes.
help.edit: Edit the selected record in a validated form. Protected and built-in records may restrict changes.
help.id: Stable identifier used by API requests and relationships. Copy it exactly; display names are not interchangeable with IDs.
help.navigate: Open this workspace or service. Existing server permissions continue to apply after navigation.
help.column: Value recorded for each row. Compare entries using the active filters; dates and quantities follow the selected locale.
help.select: Choose one supported value. This selection affects the associated form or filter and does not submit it by itself.
help.number: Enter a numeric value within the supported bounds. Empty optional fields use server defaults.
help.boolean: Enable or disable this option. Submit the form to persist configuration changes.
help.text: Edit this value in the current form. It is validated before submission; unsaved changes remain local to this page.
help.httpMethod: HTTP verb used for this request: GET reads, POST submits work, PUT replaces values and DELETE removes a resource.
help.httpStatus: HTTP outcome: 2xx succeeded, 4xx was rejected and 5xx failed on the server. A stream can still contain an error after a 200 response.
help.httpPath: Endpoint that received the request. Open details to inspect its complete URL, query parameters and payload.
help.sourceIP: Client address observed by the server. Behind a proxy this may be the proxy address unless trusted forwarding is configured.
help.stopGeneration: Cancel the active model request. Any response text already received stays visible; cancellation may take a moment to reach the engine.
help.requestBody: Enter valid JSON for the selected API operation. Path parameters are entered separately and this body is sent only when you execute the request.
help.readonly: Server-reported value. Unavailable data is distinct from zero; refresh the page data to obtain a current reading.
help.clearConversation: Clear this browser conversation and embedding preview. Stored request history and model files are retained.
help.unload: Release this model from inference memory after confirmation. Its downloaded files stay on disk.
help.chatMode: Switch to conversation mode; prompts include the visible conversation and generation settings.
help.embeddingMode: Switch to embedding mode to convert input text into a numeric vector using the selected model.
help.listAdd: Append an editable entry to this settings list. Save the settings form to persist it.
help.listRemove: Remove this entry from the settings draft. The server configuration changes only when you save.
help.platformAdmin: Grant platform-wide administrator access, bypassing tenant boundaries and RBAC checks.
help.tenantAdmin: Grant administrator access within this user’s tenant, bypassing that tenant’s RBAC checks.
help.pagination: Move through this result set or change rows per page. The current filters and tenant selection stay in effect.
help.embeddingText: Text sent to the selected embedding model to produce a numeric vector. Conversation turns and chat sampling parameters are not sent.
help.revealCredential: Retrieve and display this credential’s secret. This authorized action is audited.
help.hideCredential: Conceal the displayed secret without revoking the credential.
help.rotateCredential: Replace this secret immediately; existing integrations must use the new token.

details.notRetained: No content retained. Capture may be disabled or the response may have no body.
details.loadFailed: Full details could not be loaded. Showing list metadata.
details.measurementNote: Phase timings can overlap. Approximate backend steps are marked above. Cached-token counts remain unavailable until the engine reports them.

samplingHelp.temperature: Higher values make choices more varied; lower values favor likely tokens.
samplingHelp.num_predict: Maximum output tokens for this response, subject to the model context limit.
samplingHelp.top_p: Keep the smallest candidate set reaching this cumulative probability.
samplingHelp.top_k: Consider at most this many highest-scoring token candidates.
samplingHelp.min_p: Discard candidates whose probability is below this fraction of the best candidate.
samplingHelp.repeat_penalty: Penalize recently used tokens; 1 leaves their scores unchanged.
samplingHelp.repeat_last_n: Number of recent tokens considered when applying the repetition penalty.
samplingHelp.presence_penalty: Penalize tokens that have already appeared, encouraging new topics.
samplingHelp.frequency_penalty: Penalize tokens in proportion to how often they appeared.
samplingHelp.seed: Random sampling seed. Repeat requests with the same inputs and seed for more reproducible output.

settingHelp.readonly: Server-managed metadata; this value cannot be edited here.
settingHelp.database: Select SQLite for a local file, or MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server for a remote database. Only applicable connection fields are shown. Restart the server after changing the connection.
settingHelp.sqlite: SQLite file path inside the server. In Docker, use the mounted database path; this is not a browser file.
settingHelp.databasePort: Remote database port. Use 0 for the provider default: MySQL 3306, PostgreSQL 5432, SQL Server 1433.
settingHelp.severity: Logging library threshold: 0 debug, 1 information, 2 warning, 3 error, 4 alert, 5 critical, 6 emergency. Only messages at or above the selected level are emitted.
settingHelp.backend: Force CPU, CUDA, or Metal inference. Automatic detects available native libraries. Restart the server to apply.
settingHelp.protocol: Use gRPC, normally port 4317, or HTTP/Protobuf, normally port 4318, matching the collector endpoint.
settingHelp.collector: OTLP collector URL reachable from the server. Docker hostnames refer to the container network, not your browser.
settingHelp.accessMode: DefaultPermit allows addresses except the deny list. DefaultDeny rejects addresses unless permitted by the allow list.
settingHelp.huggingFace: Hugging Face access token used for gated or private model downloads. Obtain it from Hugging Face account settings; saving applies it to new downloads.
settingHelp.signing: Key used to protect session tokens. Changing it invalidates existing tokens after the server reloads the key.
settingHelp.adminKeys: Bearer keys with platform administrator access. Each entry is a separate secret, not a user password.
settingHelp.session: Session lifetime in minutes when issuing a new sign-in token.
settingHelp.retention: Number of days of HTTP history to retain; older entries are pruned when the server starts.
settingHelp.capture: Maximum captured body bytes per HTTP exchange. 0 disables capture of this body; truncation does not limit the actual request or response.
settingHelp.syslog: Remote syslog destinations. Each entry controls the destination host and fixed or randomized destination port.
settingHelp.syslogHost: Hostname or IP of the remote syslog receiver, resolved from the server.
settingHelp.syslogPort: Fixed destination port for syslog when randomization is disabled. Standard syslog uses 514.
settingHelp.randomize: Choose a destination port from the minimum/maximum range instead of using the fixed port.
settingHelp.minPort: Lower bound of the randomized syslog destination port range; used only when randomization is enabled.
settingHelp.maxPort: Upper bound of the randomized syslog destination port range; used only when randomization is enabled.
settingHelp.headers: Default HTTP response headers emitted by the server. Edit header names and values separately.
settingHelp.headerName: HTTP response header name, for example Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Names must be unique.
settingHelp.headerValue: Exact value emitted for this default HTTP response header. CORS values control browser access to the API.
settingHelp.quantizationName: GGUF quantization identifier used to rank downloadable model variants, for example Q4_K_M.
settingHelp.quantizationRank: Numeric download preference for GGUF quantization. Lower numbers are preferred; an empty map uses the built-in ranking.
settingHelp.directory: Directory on the server filesystem. In Docker this path must exist or be writable inside the container.
settingHelp.filename: File path or filename on the server, not on the computer running this browser.
settingHelp.library: Optional native inference library path inside the server. Leave empty to use automatic discovery; restart to apply.
settingHelp.milliseconds: Value in milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). Applies to the named server protocol setting.
settingHelp.seconds: Value in seconds. Applies to the named server protocol setting.
settingHelp.bytes: Size in bytes. Applies to the named buffer, message, or protocol limit; check the server configuration contract before changing it.
settingHelp.password: Database login secret for the selected remote provider. Stored in the server configuration, never used as a dashboard login.
settingHelp.hostname: Host or IP used by this server component. Listener settings use a bind address; remote connection settings use a destination address.
settingHelp.port: TCP or UDP port for this server component. Valid port numbers are 0 through 65535; 0 behavior depends on the component.
settingHelp.configuration: Server configuration value for {{path}}. Saved to the settings file; startup components require a server restart to apply.
settingHelp.authEnable: Mandatory bearer authentication and interactive session settings.
settingHelp.historyEnable: Record HTTP request metadata and bounded bodies for the history pages. Body capture limits are configured separately.
settingHelp.nativeLogging: Include native llama.cpp diagnostic messages in application logs; can produce substantial output. Restart to apply.
settingHelp.console: Write application log messages to the server console as well as configured log destinations. Restart to apply.
settingHelp.colors: Application logs always disable terminal colors to preserve clean JSON bodies. This saved preference does not override that behavior.
settingHelp.metrics: Export model and server measurements through OpenTelemetry. Requires telemetry to be enabled; restart to apply.
settingHelp.traces: Export distributed tracing spans through OpenTelemetry. Requires telemetry to be enabled; restart to apply.
settingHelp.logs: Export application logs over OTLP. The bundled stack already sends file logs to Loki; restart to apply.
settingHelp.http: Enable this HTTP protocol capability on the named listener. Clients and TLS settings must support it; restart to apply.
settingHelp.ssl: Enable TLS on the server listener. A suitable certificate must also be configured; restart to apply.
settingHelp.mutualTls: Require client-certificate authentication for TLS connections; clients must present a trusted certificate.
settingHelp.headersLength: Include the HTTP Content-Length response header when the server knows the body length.
settingHelp.keepAlive: Allow persistent HTTP connections instead of closing after each exchange; restart to apply.
settingHelp.accessList: IP-address rules used by the listener access-control mode. Permit and deny lists apply before route handling.

library.configurationsHelp: Reusable generation settings, including sampling, output format and streaming. System prompts are managed separately.
library.empty: No items are available in this workspace.
library.readOnlyHelp: You are creating a separate copy. Changes will not affect the original shared item.
library.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Existing conversations keep the values already submitted.
library.error: Unable to load or save the library.
library.scopeHelp: Personal items belong only to your account. Tenant admins can publish in their tenant; system admins can publish system-wide.
library.nameHelp: Use a descriptive name to distinguish this item in the Playground dropdown. Names may repeat; IDs remain unique.
library.descriptionHelp: Explain when this prompt or configuration should be used. This note is not sent to the model.
library.contentHelp: Instructions inserted before conversation messages. Saving changes affects future requests, not previous responses.
library.duplicateHelp: Create an editable copy without changing the source. Copies default to personal visibility when signed in.
library.promptSelectorHelp: Choose instructions visible to your account. Shared defaults and your private prompts appear in separate groups.
library.configurationSelectorHelp: Choose saved generation parameters. This controls sampling, stop sequences, output format, thinking and streaming.
library.editSelectionHelp: Edit an owned item. For a read-only shared default, this opens a new editable copy; saving keeps the original unchanged.
library.tenantFilterHelp: Choose the tenant whose shared defaults appear alongside system defaults and your personal items.
